card.name: Sentence-opening "As" in web prose
card.fires_on: The word "As" starting a new sentence right after a full stop or closing quote, in descriptive web text such as history, architecture or biography. It also fires on a clause-linking "as" before "measured" or "seen".

modes.label: Sentence-initial As
modes.description: "As" begins a sentence, often introducing a role, comparison or time clause.
modes.example: <<As>> Government House looked totally insignificant compared to this

modes.label: As after a quote
modes.description: "As" opens a sentence just after a closing quotation mark.
modes.example: << As>> a local community leader and a man of

modes.label: Mid-sentence as
modes.description: Lowercase "as" links to a participle such as measured.
modes.example: << as>> measured at the watershed scale.

card.writes: It seems to push toward name-like endings and away from the word "long"; the effect is not clearly meaningful.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "As" when it starts a sentence in ordinary descriptive writing.
